The normal thyroid function tests and ultrasound make a primary thyroid malignancy unlikely, and your history of colon cancer makes metastatic disease the primary concern. Given the normal imaging results you provided, I am concerned about a potential sampling error or an early lesion not yet visible; do you recall the specific size of the lump and whether it is fixed or mobile?
